_comment: Where every pixel of the game comes from. Read by tools/pack_art.py.
Ninja Adventure Asset Pack — Pixel-Boy & AAA, CC0 (public domain, no credit
required, commercial use fine). Source: github.com/pixel-boy/NinjaAdventure,
content/map/*.png, vendored unmodified in art/pack/. Coordinates are px in
those sheets; tiles are on the 16px grid.
The pack is the base layer, not the whole wardrobe: keys absent from this
file keep their generated art from tools/artgen/. That is deliberate — the
pack has no tent, no jar of the right shape and no fire, and the generated
versions of those are already readable.
mud is DELIBERATELY not from the pack: its dirt tile has vertical grooves that line up into corduroy when tiled — the same rule ART.md §5.3b sets for our own tilesets applies to borrowed ones.
rocky/cliff are not from the pack yet: the rects I could reach are the wrong colour and the rock cells need their own pass.
